exercises.title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous — Verifica argomento
exercises.description: Verifica autonoma sulla scelta tra routine/fatti e situazioni in corso o temporanee, con forma corretta del tempo scelto.
exercises.instructions: Scegli dal significato dell'intero contesto, non da una sola signal word.

sections.title: Verifica argomento
sections.instructions: Decidi prima routine/fatto oppure situazione attuale/temporanea; poi costruisci la forma.

questions.title: Item 1
questions.prompt: Luca normally works in Bologna, but this month his company has sent him to Milan.
questions.instructions: Choose the sentence that best describes this month.
questions.learning_objective: Choose Present Continuous for a temporary current situation against a stable routine.

options.text: He's working in Milan this month.
He works in Milan every month.
He working in Milan this month.

questions.title: Item 2
questions.instructions: Choose the forms that fit the meaning.
questions.learning_objective: Contrast a regular routine with an action in progress.

content.text_template: Mia usually [[blank_1]] lunch at home, but today she [[blank_2]] lunch with her classmates.

feedback.explanation: Usually routine → has; today current exception → is having.

questions.title: Item 3
questions.prompt: Correct: I am usually going to school by bus.
questions.instructions: The sentence describes a normal routine. Rewrite it correctly.
questions.learning_objective: Correct overuse of Present Continuous for a repeated habit.

accepted_answers: I usually go to school by bus.

feedback.explanation: A repeated routine uses the Present Simple here.

questions.title: Item 4
questions.prompt: I ___ the answer, but I need a moment to explain it.
questions.learning_objective: Use a basic state verb in the Present Simple.

feedback.explanation: Know is a basic state verb here: I know.

questions.title: Item 5
questions.instructions: Use the correct present tense forms.
questions.learning_objective: Switch tense appropriately across a connected routine/current context.

content.text_template: I normally [[blank_1]] (study) in the library after class, but it is closed today, so I [[blank_2]] (work) at a café. My friend Sara often [[blank_3]] (join) me, but she [[blank_4]] (not/come) today because she is ill.

questions.title: Item 6
questions.prompt: Select all sentences that fit their context correctly.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one correct answer.
questions.learning_objective: Evaluate tense choice and grammatical form together.

options.text: She works at a bank, but this week she's working from home.
Listen! Someone is knocking at the door.
My parents usually are eating at seven.

feedback.explanation: Meaning and form must both fit the context.

questions.title: Item 7
questions.learning_objective: Choose tense from conversational routine/current contrast.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: No, I usually bring lunch from home.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: So why are you here today?

options.text: I'm meeting a friend nearby after lunch.
I meet a friend nearby right now every day.
I meeting a friend nearby after lunch.

feedback.explanation: Today/current temporary plan around now: Present Continuous.

questions.title: Item 8
questions.prompt: Di solito lavoro in ufficio, ma questa settimana sto lavorando da casa.
questions.learning_objective: Produce routine versus temporary contrast in one sentence.

accepted_answers: I usually work in the office, but this week I'm working from home.
I usually work in an office, but this week I am working from home.

feedback.explanation: Usually work; this week am working.

questions.title: Item 9
questions.prompt: Correct both tense choices: Marta is working in a hospital every day. Today she works from home because the hospital is closed.
questions.instructions: Rewrite both sentences so the routine/current contrast is correct.
questions.learning_objective: Correct reversed tense choices across routine and temporary contexts.

accepted_answers: Marta works in a hospital every day. Today she is working from home because the hospital is closed.
Marta works in a hospital every day. Today she's working from home because the hospital is closed.

feedback.explanation: Stable routine → works; temporary today → is working.

questions.title: Item 10
questions.prompt: Mia vuole un caffè, ma non ne beve di solito. Oggi sta studiando fino a tardi e ne sta bevendo uno adesso.
questions.instructions: Translate the full context into English.
questions.learning_objective: Combine a state verb, habitual negative and current actions in connected production.

accepted_answers: Mia wants a coffee, but she doesn't usually drink coffee. Today she's studying until late and she's drinking one now.
Mia wants a coffee, but she does not usually drink coffee. Today she is studying until late and she is drinking one now.

feedback.explanation: Wants/state + habitual negative simple; current actions continuous.
